# Heathrow Mini Cab

> Heathrow Mini Cab is a Heathrow and West London minicab and private hire company offering airport transfers, school runs, local rides and corporate travel.

Website: https://www.bittacycars.com
Phone: 020 3761 7526
Email: info@bittacycars.com
Location: Heathrow, London, United Kingdom

## Services

- Airport transfers to and from Heathrow Terminals 2, 3, 4 and 5, plus Gatwick, Stansted, Luton, London City and Southend Airport.
- School runs across West London with DBS-checked drivers and regular route planning.
- Local minicab rides across Heathrow, Hounslow, Hayes, Harlington, West Drayton, Feltham, Staines, Uxbridge, Slough, Ealing, Southall, Twickenham and nearby areas.
- Corporate travel with executive vehicles, priority booking, corporate accounts and monthly invoicing.

## Booking

Customers can book by calling 020 3761 7526 or by using the booking and contact forms on the website.
